jobs.title: Director of AI Applications Development
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As part of CIBC’s technology team, you’ll lead our AI Applications Development function and guide a high-performing team of AI engineers, developers, and quality assurance specialists who build and support enterprise-grade AI solutions. As Director, you’ll provide technical and people leadership to drive the design, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution of advanced AI applications across the bank. You’ll work closely with technology and business partners to shape solution architecture, define integration requirements, and deliver solutions that align to strategic priorities and enterprise standards. You’ll help ensure our AI-driven applications are secure, scalable, reliable, and well monitored, with a strong focus on cloud-native delivery, observability, and compliance. You’ll also foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and strong documentation practices while supporting your leaders and teams in delivering high-quality solutions that enhance the client experience.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

How You'll Succeed

People leadership - Lead and develop a team of leaders, AI engineers, developers, and quality assurance specialists by setting clear direction, providing meaningful coaching, and creating opportunities for growth. Build an inclusive, high-performing environment where team members are supported, accountable, and connected to CIBC’s priorities.
Strategic partnership - Build trusted relationships with technology and business partners, vendors, and senior stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into practical AI solutions, and influence decisions through clear, business-focused communication.
Technical leadership - Guide architecture and engineering decisions for enterprise AI applications, with a focus on security, scalability, performance, and reliability. Support the development and deployment of modern AI solutions using tools and technologies such as Python, FastAPI, JavaScript frameworks, Azure AI services, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI frameworks.
Quality and platform excellence - Champion strong engineering practices across cloud infrastructure, continuous integration and continuous delivery, observability, documentation, and test automation to help ensure solutions are resilient, maintainable, and ready for enterprise scale.
Delivery leadership - Work with internal partners to prioritize, plan, and deliver initiatives on agreed timelines and budgets. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, encourage reuse across teams, and help shape a shared AI strategy that scales across the enterprise.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on builder first. You have recently designed, built, and shipped production AI applications yourself, and you still enjoy writing code, reviewing pull requests, and solving production issues alongside the team.
You bring strong technical depth. You have hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, JavaScript (Vue.js or React.js), SQL, Redis, and Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry and API Management. You are comfortable with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions and QA automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
You know modern AI engineering. You have built solutions using large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt and context engineering, tool calling, and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LangSmith, or equivalent. It’s an asset if you have experience with Databricks, LLM evaluation, and observability for AI agents in production (e.g., Splunk, OpenTelemetry).
You build for the enterprise. You design for security, scalability, reliability, and compliance, and you understand what it takes to run AI safely in a regulated environment.
You are ready to grow as a people leader. You mentor engineers, set technical direction, and raise the engineering bar. You are excited to grow into leading a team of engineers and QA specialists as the function scales.
Your influence makes a difference. You build trusted relationships with business and technology partners, translate business needs into practical AI solutions, and explain complex ideas clearly to non-technical audiences.
You're digitally savvy. You are curious, adapt quickly to new tools and trends, and take ownership of outcomes in a fast-moving space.
You live your values. You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What You Need To Know

CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).
We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Technology Operations & Security
jobs.description:
About YPO

YPO is a global leadership community of over 35,000 chief executives from more than 140 countries. YPO brings together extraordinary leaders who are committed to becoming better leaders and better people. The organization provides a platform for the leaders to connect, learn, and grow through shared experiences, rich learning programs, and meaningful relationships. Members benefit from a supportive community that fosters personal, business, family and community growth.

Supporting these members is a world-class management team of more than 450 associates, spanning over 25 countries. Our organization is based in Dallas, Texas, with many associates working virtually and outside of the United States. Together, our team of global associates works to create a truly Only-in-YPO experience for our members

Position Details

This is a remote work-from-home position.
Although this position is remote, candidates must reside in British Columbia, Ontario, Alberta or Nova Scotia
as YPO is not an employer in other Canadian provinces.

Work Hours:
Candidates must be flexible to accommodate time zones of international stakeholders when necessary.

POSITION PURPOSE

YPO is seeking a Senior Director of Technology Operations and Security to lead enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, business continuity, and technology vendor management, ensuring a secure, reliable, resilient, and cost-effective technology environment.

This leader is accountable for the technology services that enable YPO associates to operate effectively, including corporate infrastructure, enterprise IT services, end-user technology, access management, and IT support. The role also leads YPO's enterprise cybersecurity program, establishing policies, standards, and controls that protect organizational and member data across YPO's technology environment.

Working closely with Engineering, Risk and Compliance, Finance, and other departments, the Senior Director strengthens operational resilience, improves the associate technology experience, manages technology risks, and drives disciplined oversight of technology vendors and investments. The role must enable and accelerate AI adoption across YPO by establishing the secure technology environment, governance, and operational capabilities needed to deploy and scale AI solutions. Partners with departments to remove technical barriers, simplify access to approved AI tools, and empower associates to leverage AI effectively and responsibly.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise IT Operations and Infrastructure

Ensure YPO associates have secure, reliable technology and responsive support to perform their jobs effectively.
Lead enterprise IT operations, including corporate infrastructure, end-user technology, IT support, and administration of assigned enterprise systems.
Oversee technology onboarding, role changes, and offboarding to ensure associates and contractors receive appropriate system access and timely removal of access.
Partner with HR, Contracts, and department leaders to improve technology provisioning, deprovisioning, and access management processes.
Establish standards for device management, software deployment, identity administration, and IT service delivery.
Ensure corporate devices and IT-managed systems are appropriately configured, maintained, secured, and supported.
Leverage AI and automation to streamline IT support, proactively identify issues, and reduce manual administrative work.
Use operational data and service metrics to continuously improve IT performance, efficiency, response times, resolutions times, and associate experience.
Ensure enterprise technology services, support processes, and deployment standards are designed to operate effectively across YPO’s global locations, including differing connectivity, time-zone, language, regulatory, and local support requirements.

Business Continuity and Operational Resilience

Minimize disruptions to YPO's internal operations and ensure critical corporate technology services can recover quickly from outages and other incidents.
Develop and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans for corporate IT infrastructure, enterprise IT services, and other technology systems within the team's operational responsibility.
Identify critical internal technology services, dependencies, and risks that could disrupt associate productivity or organizational operations.
Coordinate regular disaster recovery testing, incident simulations, and continuity exercises to validate operational readiness.
undefined
Partner with Engineering and other system owners to identify shared dependencies, coordinate recovery procedures, and address risks that span multiple technology functions.
Report material continuity risks, recovery readiness, and remediation progress to Technology leadership.

Cybersecurity and Technology Risk Management

Protect YPO's organizational and member data by establishing and maintaining effective enterprise security policies, controls, and risk management practices.
Lead YPO's enterprise information security program, including cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and data protection.
Oversee enterprise security monitoring, threat detection, security incident response, investigation, and remediation coordination.
Partners with Engineering, Product, Data, Legal, and Risk and Compliance to ensure security and privacy requirements are incorporated into technology solutions and operations.
Oversee the evaluation and implementation of appropriate cybersecurity frameworks, third-party technology security assessments, audits, and certifications.
Build a strong security culture through associate awareness, training, and clear accountability for protecting YPO systems and data.
Maintain visibility into material cybersecurity risks and regularly report security posture, incidents, and remediation progress to leadership.

Technology Vendor and Financial Management

Establish disciplined oversight of YPO's technology vendors, software portfolio, and investments to reduce unnecessary spending, duplication, and operational risk.
Lead enterprise technology vendor management, including software governance, vendor performance, contract oversight, license management, and cost optimization.
Oversee the centralized software intake and evaluation process to ensure new technology investments meet business needs, security requirements, and financial expectations.
Drive software portfolio rationalization by identifying opportunities to consolidate redundant tools, eliminate underutilized licenses, and simplify YPO's technology ecosystem.
Partner with Finance and department leaders to improve technology budgeting, cost allocation, forecasting, and financial accountability.
Use data, AI, and automation to improve visibility into technology spending, license utilization, vendor performance, and cost-saving opportunities.

People Leadership and Strategic Oversight

Build a high-performing technology operations organization that balances security, reliability, service quality, and financial discipline.
Lead, coach, and develop managers and associates across enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, and technology vendor management.
Translate organizational priorities into a clear technology operations strategy, roadmap, and measurable performance objectives.
Establish accountability, service standards, operating procedures, and performance metrics across all areas of responsibility.
Manage assigned technology operations budgets, resources, and vendor investments to ensure effective allocation and financial stewardship.
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to align security standards, operational dependencies, and technology governance requirements.
Collaborate with department leaders to understand organizational needs, identify operational risks, and prioritize improvements that deliver value.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, cross-functional collaboration, ownership, and proactive problem-solving.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance service delivery.
Communicate technology performance, risks, investment needs, and operational priorities clearly to executive leadership and other stakeholders.

SKILLS

Enterprise IT Operations and Resilience

Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, corporate networks, identity management, end-user technology, and IT service management.
Knowledge of business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resilience, and technology risk management.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Engineering and other system owners on shared infrastructure, security requirements, and operational dependencies.

Cybersecurity and Risk

Strong knowledge of information security, cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, data protection, and incident response.
Understanding of relevant security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into practical, business-friendly processes.
Ability to assess and mitigate enterprise technology, vendor, and AI-related security risks.

Technology and Financial Management

Strong technology portfolio, vendor, contract, budget, and license management skills.
Ability to evaluate technology investments, assess vendor performance, and identify opportunities to consolidate tools and reduce costs.
Strong financial acumen, including technology budgeting, forecasting, cost optimization, and investment prioritization.
Ability to establish governance processes that balance organizational needs, operational efficiency, and risk.

AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance service delivery.
Ability to identify, prioritize, and implement automation opportunities that improve service quality, efficiency, and scalability.
Familiarity with AI-related security, governance, and operational considerations.

Leadership and Collaboration

Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, talent development, performance management, and organizational planning.
Ability to lead multiple technology disciplines while balancing strategic priorities and day-to-day operational needs.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to communicate complex technology risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to nontechnical audiences.
Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
Ability to lead organizational change, establish accountability, and drive measurable operational improvements.

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, technology infrastructure, or related technology leadership roles.
8+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers or multiple technology functions.
Demonstrated experience overseeing enterprise IT operations, corporate infrastructure, cybersecurity, and end-user technology support.
Experience leading cybersecurity programs, managing technology risks, and supporting security assessments, audits, or compliance initiatives.
Experience consolidating technology platforms, improving license utilization, and delivering measurable technology cost savings.
Experience partnering with Engineering and other technology teams to establish security requirements, manage shared risks, and coordinate operational responsibilities.
Experience leading distributed teams and deploying, scaling, and supporting technology operations across multiple countries, geographies, and time zones, with an understanding of the operational, cultural, connectivity, and support requireme

jobs.title: Director, Technical Program Management
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

We are looking for a Director of Technical Program Management to lead a senior team of TPMs driving Instacart's most critical Engineering Foundations initiatives across Data Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure, Platform, AI enablement, Privacy, and Reliability. In this highly visible role, you will shape the strategy and direction of company-critical, cross-functional programs while staying hands-on in how they are planned and delivered. You will partner closely with VPs and Directors of Engineering, Finance, Legal, GRC, Data Science, and other cross-functional leaders. This is a terrific opportunity for a technical leader who is passionate about people, program management, and engineering, and who understands that our success hinges on our ability to deliver impact as a team.

The Technical Program Management team leads Instacart's most impactful cross-functional efforts, bringing technical expertise, product sense, and business acumen to deliver highly complex initiatives at scale.

About The Job

Lead and grow a senior team of TPMs, building a vision for a high-performing TPM organization while actively mentoring and developing individuals to succeed.
Shape the vision, strategy, and investment needs across Engineering Foundations, including data product strategy, data quality and governance, financial data transformation, AI enablement, privacy, and reliability.
Drive a step change in how Engineering Foundations operates: clear reliability expectations, real-time visibility into top-line metrics, and proactive investment decisions owned by each pillar.
Partner with VPs, Senior Directors, and Directors of Engineering and with leaders in Finance, Legal, and Security to enable effective strategic planning and timely execution of company-critical programs.
Present regularly to the CTO and influence engineering leadership on key investments needed to hold a high bar on our operational health.
Use your technical knowledge and product sense to drive data-driven decisions, negotiate prioritization, weigh long-term and short-term investments, and reduce ambiguity and risk.
Enable the company to expand into new markets with privacy and regulatory compliance in strong shape.
Build a team culture of curiosity, impact, and ownership that reinforces the core values of Instacart.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
12+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, product management in a technical domain, or a related discipline.
Track record as both a strong individual contributor and a people leader, with experience leading and growing a team of TPMs or engineers.
Experience in infrastructure domains (such as data infrastructure, developer infrastructure, platform, reliability, or privacy) at scale.
Demonstrated influence on technical or business strategy, with a record of measurable outcomes delivered for the organization.
Proven ability to influence senior engineering and executive leaders, resolve conflict, and build consensus while navigating ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in infrastructure at a leading technology company operating at scale, as both an individual contributor and a leader.
Experience with data governance, privacy, or regulatory compliance programs.
Experience supporting executive-level operating reviews and engineering planning processes.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

About this opportunity:

We are seeking a Director of Customer Operations to lead end‑to‑end operational excellence across Cloud Software & Services (CSS) engagements, for one of the leading customers in Canada. This is a CFR (Customer Fulfillment Responsible) role and as part of the Core-3 engagements, expected to lead the fulfillment part through the sale and delivery lifecycle. Reporting to the Head of Operations CSS Canada, the role is accountable for customer delivery performance, operational governance, financial discipline, and cross‑functional execution, ensuring CSS delivers high‑quality outcomes at scale while continuously improving customer experience and profitability.

The Director of Customer Operations partners closely with Customer Units (CUs), Sales, Delivery, PMO, Product, and Business Operations to translate strategy into execution and drive predictable outcomes for CSS business and customer success.

What you will do:

Own end‑to‑end customer delivery performance across CSS engagements, ensuring delivery commitments, SLAs, and contractual outcomes are met.
Drive operational rigor across delivery governance, escalation management, risk mitigation, and customer satisfaction.
Act as the senior operational interface for key customer engagements, working in close partnership with account leadership.
Lead customer steering meetings for reporting progress on critical programs and tracking key issues, escalations etc.
Establish and lead operating rhythms, governance forums, and performance reviews across CSS delivery units.
Monitor operational and financial KPIs including delivery health, margin, forecast accuracy, cost control, and customer experience metrics.
Identify performance trends and drive corrective actions across portfolios and delivery teams.
Partner with Finance and Business Operations to ensure strong cost and margin control, resource planning, and forecasting accuracy.
Drive optimal utilization of delivery resources while balancing quality, speed, and financial outcomes.
Support annual business planning, quarterly forecasting, and monthly operational reviews.
Collaborate with PMO, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Units to ensure seamless execution from presales through delivery.
Align CSS operational execution with customer expectations, commercial commitments, and portfolio strategy.
Influence without authority across a matrix organization to deliver results.
Lead and develop a high‑performing operations leadership team, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Drive competence readiness, talent development, and succession planning within Customer Operations.
Promote a culture of customer focus, transparency, and operational excellence.

The skills you bring:

Director‑level experience leading customer operations, service delivery, or large‑scale programs within software, core and cloud services.
Proven track record of managing complex customer environments, financial performance, and cross‑functional stakeholders.
Strong experience with operational governance, KPI‑driven execution, and performance management.
Financial acumen with experience managing delivery cost, margin, and forecasting.
Experience operating in matrixed, global organizations.
Executive‑level communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description

Job Overview:

The Vice President, General Ledger Accounting
will lead the General Ledger Accounting function for an assigned portfolio of markets and regions. The Vice President is accountable for the overall performance of the GL teams that prepare, review and deliver monthly financial statements and related client deliverables for the communities supported within that portfolio.

Reporting to the SVP, Client Accounting, the Vice President will establish the strategic direction, operating priorities and performance expectations for the assigned GL organization. The role will work closely with market and regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and Client Accounting Shared Services partners to ensure financial statements are accurate, timely and supported by consistent processes, strong controls, effective issue escalation and disciplined performance management.

The Vice President will lead transformation and standardization across the assigned portfolio while ensuring the operating model remains responsive to local market needs, management agreements, governing documents and client expectations. The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically strong and service-oriented leader who can develop leaders, create accountability, resolve complex reporting issues and improve the quality, consistency and efficiency of financial statement delivery.

Due to the global nature of this position, the Vice President should be comfortable working across multiple time zones (Pacific Standard Time to Eastern Standard Time), within reason.

Job Responsibilities

The job duties listed are typical examples of the work performed by positions in this job classification. Not all duties assigned to every position are included, nor is it expected that all positions will be assigned every duty.

General Ledger Accounting

Provide executive ownership of the monthly close and financial statement reporting cycle for all communities within the assigned portfolio, ensuring accurate and timely delivery in accordance with internal policies and procedures, regulatory requirements, management agreements, property governing documents and client expectations.
Establish the portfolio’s operating rhythm, reporting timetables, quality standards, review protocols, escalation paths and delivery-tracking requirements for monthly financial statements.
Ensure the integrity of general ledger activity, including account reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses and amortization, fixed assets, interfund and reserve activity, cost recovery billings and other client deliverables.
Serve as the senior escalation authority for complex accounting matters, financial statement exceptions, late or at-risk deliverables and significant client or operational issues within the assigned portfolio.
Oversee GL support for annual client audits and budgets, special assessments, loans, mortgages and other significant client financial obligations.
Establish and monitor service level and key performance indicators for financial statement delivery
Drive leadership accountability for results against service-level and key performance indicators, reviewing performance regularly and leading corrective action plans where targets are missed.
Build the leadership capability, succession plans, organizational structure and workforce capacity required to support client growth, retention and changing business needs.
Attract, develop and retain high-caliber leaders and accounting professionals while promoting a culture of collaboration, accountability, trust and service excellence.

Business Partner

Serve as the senior Client Accounting business partner for market presidents, regional leaders, Financial Management leadership and other senior stakeholders within the assigned portfolio.
Partner with the VP, Accounts Receivable and Resales; VP, Accounts Payable; Senior Director, Treasury Services; and other Client Accounting leaders to ensure cohesive end-to-end service delivery and timely resolution of cross-functional issues.
Translate portfolio performance, operational trends and accounting risks into clear recommendations and decisions for the SVP, Client Accounting and senior market leadership.
Build strong relationships with supported markets to understand local culture, client requirements and operating needs while reinforcing enterprise standards and shared-services objectives.
Act as a senior resource for board members, property and association managers and other stakeholders by leading the resolution of significant accounting and financial reporting matters.
Represent General Ledger Accounting in senior leadership forums, cross-functional initiatives and major business decisions affecting client accounting and reporting.

Financial Planning

Develop and manage the GL operating budget for the assigned portfolio, including headcount planning, forecasts, productivity assumptions and variance analysis.
Align staffing, leadership capacity and workload to the monthly close cycle, client growth, market transitions and service requirements.
Develop business cases and investment recommendations for organizational changes, systems, automation, training and process improvement initiatives.
Monitor portfolio capacity and cost-to-serve indicators and take action when workload or service demand exceeds available resources.

People Management

Lead a team of 125+ associates through a senior leadership structure within North America
Attract, develop and retain diverse, high-caliber talent, while developing an engaged team to build the capabilities required for the organization to perform at high levels.
Promote a culture of collaboration, trust and support.
Clearly define and communicate performance responsibilities, goals, expectations and objectives.
Regularly evaluate teams to determine performance and whether company standards for work performance are met. If expectations are not met, are responsible for coaching and corrective actions.
Conduct ongoing performance management activities by providing constructive feedback and coaching through regular check-ins, structured one-on-one meetings, mid-year touchpoints and annual reviews.

Project Management

Provide executive sponsorship and governance for large-scale GL initiatives affecting the assigned portfolio, including market integrations, client transitions and accounting platform migrations.
Establish project objectives, decision rights, accountability, milestones, risks and escalation paths in partnership with project and functional leaders.
Ensure market and GL team readiness through effective planning, communication, training, change management and post-implementation support.
Provide clear status updates to senior leadership on timeline, accomplishments, decisions, risks, issues and required support.

Business Process Improvement

Lead the standardization and continuous improvement of GL processes, review practices, controls and workflows across the assigned markets and regions.
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, service-level expectations, process documentation and governance for the GL function.
Partner with the Business Transformation and technology teams to define business requirements, prioritize enhancements, improve reporting capabilities and support adoption of enterprise accounting platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to automate, centralize or redesign work while maintaining accountability, control integrity and service quality.
Develop dashboards that provide visibility into financial statement delivery, quality, productivity, backlog, capacity, risk and technology adoption.
Use performance data, root-cause analysis and market feedback to identify systemic issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
Share and implement leading practices across the GL organization and collaborate with peer functional leaders to improve end-to-end Client Accounting processes.

Compliance & Governance

Maintain an effective internal control environment over the general ledger and financial reporting functions, including segregation of duties, review controls, documentation standards and escalation procedures.
Ensure GL processes adhere to applicable accounting standards, federal and state requirements, company policies, standard operating procedures, management agreements and client-specific obligations.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors on audit requests, control reviews, year-end support and remediation activities.
Monitor regulatory, accounting and industry developments that may affect client accounting operations and lead implementation of required changes across the assigned portfolio.
Ensure the appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information and safeguard client and company assets.

Additional Duties

Partner with the SVP, Client Accounting and other GL leaders to carry out the strategy, operating model and priorities for General Ledger Accounting.
Practice and adhere to FirstService Residential Global Service Standards.
Always conduct business with the highest standards of personal, professional and ethical conduct.
Anticipate needs across supported markets and manage department resources to provide timely and reliable service; prioritize and communicate when requests exceed capacity.
Complete special projects and perform other duties as assigned related to the stated objective for the position.

Skills & Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Strong analytical skills to perform data collection and benchmarking against best practices.
Manage in a no surprises manner; proactively communicate financial issues to leaders.
Ability to communicate a clear strategy and vision for General Ledger Accounting across our organization and have experience in leading change management initiatives that bring people, process, and technology together from different functional areas to deliver a quality financial services customer experience necessary.
Passion for gaining efficiency through process change while creating a positive team environment where we can recruit, develop, and retain talent.
Comfort with rolling out new technologies, automation and outsourcing to third parties to improve accuracy, timeliness and maximize efficiencies a must.
Knowledge leader in both financial accounting and the Condo/HOA industry. Sound business acumen and the ability to present practical solutions is a key requirement.
Experience interacting with or working through change management items with field operations personnel.
Exposure to a company/industry in rapid transformation (people, process, technology, customer experience).
Familiarity with projects focused on the implementation of new enterprise-wide technology platforms.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with high level of independence and accountability for their work.
Familiarity or practical experience with Agile program management methodology necessary.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree plus an accounting designation is essential together with prior experience in a senior financial operations role.

Physical Requirements & Working Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

Dexterity for keyboard and mouse use

Position Details

This is a remote work-from-home position.
Although this position is remote, candidates must reside in British Columbia, Ontario, Alberta or Nova Scotia
as YPO is not an employer in other Canadian provinces.

Work Hours:
Candidates must be flexible to accommodate time zones of international stakeholders when necessary.

POSITION PURPOSE

YPO is seeking a Senior Director of Technology Operations and Security to lead enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, business continuity, and technology vendor management, ensuring a secure, reliable, resilient, and cost-effective technology environment.

This leader is accountable for the technology services that enable YPO associates to operate effectively, including corporate infrastructure, enterprise IT services, end-user technology, access management, and IT support. The role also leads YPO's enterprise cybersecurity program, establishing policies, standards, and controls that protect organizational and member data across YPO's technology environment.

Working closely with Engineering, Risk and Compliance, Finance, and other departments, the Senior Director strengthens operational resilience, improves the associate technology experience, manages technology risks, and drives disciplined oversight of technology vendors and investments. The role must enable and accelerate AI adoption across YPO by establishing the secure technology environment, governance, and operational capabilities needed to deploy and scale AI solutions. Partners with departments to remove technical barriers, simplify access to approved AI tools, and empower associates to leverage AI effectively and responsibly.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise IT Operations and Infrastructure

Ensure YPO associates have secure, reliable technology and responsive support to perform their jobs effectively.
Lead enterprise IT operations, including corporate infrastructure, end-user technology, IT support, and administration of assigned enterprise systems.
Oversee technology onboarding, role changes, and offboarding to ensure associates and contractors receive appropriate system access and timely removal of access.
Partner with HR, Contracts, and department leaders to improve technology provisioning, deprovisioning, and access management processes.
Establish standards for device management, software deployment, identity administration, and IT service delivery.
Ensure corporate devices and IT-managed systems are appropriately configured, maintained, secured, and supported.
Leverage AI and automation to streamline IT support, proactively identify issues, and reduce manual administrative work.
Use operational data and service metrics to continuously improve IT performance, efficiency, response times, resolutions times, and associate experience.
Ensure enterprise technology services, support processes, and deployment standards are designed to operate effectively across YPO’s global locations, including differing connectivity, time-zone, language, regulatory, and local support requirements.

Business Continuity and Operational Resilience

Minimize disruptions to YPO's internal operations and ensure critical corporate technology services can recover quickly from outages and other incidents.
Develop and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans for corporate IT infrastructure, enterprise IT services, and other technology systems within the team's operational responsibility.
Identify critical internal technology services, dependencies, and risks that could disrupt associate productivity or organizational operations.
Coordinate regular disaster recovery testing, incident simulations, and continuity exercises to validate operational readiness.
undefined

Report material continuity risks, recovery readiness, and remediation progress to Technology leadership.

Cybersecurity and Technology Risk Management

Protect YPO's organizational and member data by establishing and maintaining effective enterprise security policies, controls, and risk management practices.
Lead YPO's enterprise information security program, including cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and data protection.
Oversee enterprise security monitoring, threat detection, security incident response, investigation, and remediation coordination.
Partners with Engineering, Product, Data, Legal, and Risk and Compliance to ensure security and privacy requirements are incorporated into technology solutions and operations.
Oversee the evaluation and implementation of appropriate cybersecurity frameworks, third-party technology security assessments, audits, and certifications.
Build a strong security culture through associate awareness, training, and clear accountability for protecting YPO systems and data.
Maintain visibility into material cybersecurity risks and regularly report security posture, incidents, and remediation progress to leadership.

Technology Vendor and Financial Management

Establish disciplined oversight of YPO's technology vendors, software portfolio, and investments to reduce unnecessary spending, duplication, and operational risk.
Lead enterprise technology vendor management, including software governance, vendor performance, contract oversight, license management, and cost optimization.
Oversee the centralized software intake and evaluation process to ensure new technology investments meet business needs, security requirements, and financial expectations.
Drive software portfolio rationalization by identifying opportunities to consolidate redundant tools, eliminate underutilized licenses, and simplify YPO's technology ecosystem.
Partner with Finance and department leaders to improve technology budgeting, cost allocation, forecasting, and financial accountability.
Use data, AI, and automation to improve visibility into technology spending, license utilization, vendor performance, and cost-saving opportunities.

People Leadership and Strategic Oversight

Build a high-performing technology operations organization that balances security, reliability, service quality, and financial discipline.
Lead, coach, and develop managers and associates across enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, and technology vendor management.
Translate organizational priorities into a clear technology operations strategy, roadmap, and measurable performance objectives.
Establish accountability, service standards, operating procedures, and performance metrics across all areas of responsibility.
Manage assigned technology operations budgets, resources, and vendor investments to ensure effective allocation and financial stewardship.
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to align security standards, operational dependencies, and technology governance requirements.
Collaborate with department leaders to understand organizational needs, identify operational risks, and prioritize improvements that deliver value.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, cross-functional collaboration, ownership, and proactive problem-solving.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance service delivery.

Ability to coordinate effectively with Engineering and other system owners on shared infrastructure, security requirements, and operational dependencies.

new_jobs.description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

The Opportunity

Dover Fueling Solutions is seeking a commercial leader to shape the next phase of growth

for Bulloch POS in Canada. Bulloch is a proven point-of-sale technology platform with a

strong position in the Canadian market.

The immediate mandate is clear: build and embed a disciplined, scalable account

management model that deepens our most important customer relationships, strengthens

execution, and creates durable growth.

The Director will engage senior IT and business leaders at large enterprise accounts,

translate their priorities and technology roadmaps into actionable account strategies, and

coordinate DFS resources to deliver long-term customer value.

Additional focus will be selective new-logo growth with Canadian retailers not currently

using Bulloch. These are strategic pursuits with sales cycles that can extend several years

and require thoughtful relationship development, technical credibility, and disciplined

opportunity management.

The Director will lead a team and have significant exposure across DFS. After establishing a

strong Canadian account management framework and demonstrating sustained

execution, the successful candidate may have opportunities to contribute to Bulloch’s

longer-term U.S. growth agenda.

What You Will Own

Build the account management system. Design and implement a consistent

framework for account planning, customer governance, opportunity management,

executive engagement, and performance reviews across Bulloch Canada.

Lead and grow strategic accounts. Develop multi-year plans connecting customer

technology priorities with Bulloch capabilities, investments, and measurable

business outcomes.

Become a trusted partner to enterprise technology leaders. Build credibility with

senior IT, technology, operations, and business stakeholders and understand their

roadmaps, integration requirements, risks, and priorities.

Create disciplined customer governance. Establish executive business reviews,

account health assessments, stakeholder maps, opportunity pipelines, and clear

accountability for customer commitments.

Drive retention, expansion, and lifetime value. Identify opportunities to deepen

relationships through additional deployments, software, services, and evolving

customer requirements.

Win targeted new logos. Lead selective pursuits with Canadian retailers not

currently using Bulloch, recognizing the strategic and long-term nature of these

opportunities.

Lead regional selling directly. Take an active role in solution positioning, deal

shaping, qualification, negotiation, and closing with smaller regional and

independent retailers.

Develop a high-performing team. Coach direct reports in strategic account

management, commercial discipline, executive engagement, and opportunity

development.

Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Work across Product, Engineering,

Implementation, Customer Success, Support, Service, Marketing, and Finance to

remove obstacles and deliver a consistent customer experience.

Bring the market into the business. Translate customer feedback, competitive

dynamics, and technology trends into actionable insights for product and business

leadership.

Operate with commercial rigor. Own forecasting, pipeline quality, account KPIs,

quarterly planning, and transparent reporting of opportunities and risks.

What Success Looks Like

Within The First 12–18 Months

A repeatable account management framework is operating across Canada and

actively used by the team.

Strategic customers have clear account plans, governance cadences, stakeholder

maps, and documented growth priorities.

Bulloch strengthens retention and share of wallet while building credible long-term

pipelines with targeted new customers.

Customer commitments are better coordinated across DFS, with clearer ownership

and fewer execution gaps.

The team demonstrates stronger commercial discipline and executive-level

customer engagement.

Bulloch’s Canadian business is positioned to scale without relying on tribal

knowledge or individual relationships.

What You Bring

7+ years of progressive B2B sales, strategic account management, or commercial

leadership experience, ideally in enterprise software, SaaS, POS, payments, retail

technology, or another complex technology environment.

Demonstrated success building or materially improving strategic account

management practices, rather than simply operating within an established process.

Experience managing large enterprise customers with complex stakeholder groups

and long-term technology roadmaps.

Confidence engaging senior IT and business leaders and translating technical

requirements into commercial strategy.

Strong commercial judgment across account planning, opportunity qualification,

negotiation, forecasting, and long-cycle selling.

Experience developing people and creating accountability within a small, high

impact team.

Ability to influence effectively across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and

Other Functions Without Relying On Formal Authority.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to distill complexity

into clear decisions and actions.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Ability to travel as required to customers and DFS locations.

Preferred Experience

Canadian retail, convenience, fuel, or multi-site enterprise technology experience.
POS, payments, forecourt, or adjacent retail technology experience.
Challenger, MEDDPICC, or another disciplined enterprise-selling methodology.
Experience working within a global technology organization and distributed cross

functional teams.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to shape how a market-leading technology business manages its

most important customer relationships.

The successful candidate will have the mandate to build, not simply maintain—creating

the account management discipline that supports Bulloch’s next stage of growth while

gaining exposure to senior customers and leaders across Dover Fueling Solutions.

For a high-potential commercial leader, the role provides a platform to demonstrate

enterprise leadership and expand into broader growth responsibilities over time.

About YPO

YPO is a global leadership community of over 35,000 chief executives from more than 140 countries. YPO brings together extraordinary leaders who are committed to becoming better leaders and better people. The organization provides a platform for the leaders to connect, learn, and grow through shared experiences, rich learning programs, and meaningful relationships. Members benefit from a supportive community that fosters personal, business, family and community growth.

Supporting these members is a world-class management team of more than 450 associates, spanning over 25 countries. Our organization is based in Dallas, Texas, with many associates working virtually and outside of the United States. Together, our team of global associates works to create a truly Only-in-YPO experience for our members

Position Details

This is a remote work-from-home position.
Although this position is remote, candidates must reside in British Columbia, Ontario, Alberta or Nova Scotia
as YPO is not an employer in other Canadian provinces.

Work Hours:
Candidates must be flexible to accommodate time zones of international stakeholders when necessary.

POSITION PURPOSE

YPO is seeking a Senior Director of Technology Operations and Security to lead enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, business continuity, and technology vendor management, ensuring a secure, reliable, resilient, and cost-effective technology environment.

This leader is accountable for the technology services that enable YPO associates to operate effectively, including corporate infrastructure, enterprise IT services, end-user technology, access management, and IT support. The role also leads YPO's enterprise cybersecurity program, establishing policies, standards, and controls that protect organizational and member data across YPO's technology environment.

Working closely with Engineering, Risk and Compliance, Finance, and other departments, the Senior Director strengthens operational resilience, improves the associate technology experience, manages technology risks, and drives disciplined oversight of technology vendors and investments. The role must enable and accelerate AI adoption across YPO by establishing the secure technology environment, governance, and operational capabilities needed to deploy and scale AI solutions. Partners with departments to remove technical barriers, simplify access to approved AI tools, and empower associates to leverage AI effectively and responsibly.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise IT Operations and Infrastructure

Ensure YPO associates have secure, reliable technology and responsive support to perform their jobs effectively.
Lead enterprise IT operations, including corporate infrastructure, end-user technology, IT support, and administration of assigned enterprise systems.
Oversee technology onboarding, role changes, and offboarding to ensure associates and contractors receive appropriate system access and timely removal of access.
Partner with HR, Contracts, and department leaders to improve technology provisioning, deprovisioning, and access management processes.
Establish standards for device management, software deployment, identity administration, and IT service delivery.
Ensure corporate devices and IT-managed systems are appropriately configured, maintained, secured, and supported.
Leverage AI and automation to streamline IT support, proactively identify issues, and reduce manual administrative work.
Use operational data and service metrics to continuously improve IT performance, efficiency, response times, resolutions times, and associate experience.
Ensure enterprise technology services, support processes, and deployment standards are designed to operate effectively across YPO’s global locations, including differing connectivity, time-zone, language, regulatory, and local support requirements.

Business Continuity and Operational Resilience

Minimize disruptions to YPO's internal operations and ensure critical corporate technology services can recover quickly from outages and other incidents.
Develop and maintain business continuity and disaster recovery plans for corporate IT infrastructure, enterprise IT services, and other technology systems within the team's operational responsibility.
Identify critical internal technology services, dependencies, and risks that could disrupt associate productivity or organizational operations.
Coordinate regular disaster recovery testing, incident simulations, and continuity exercises to validate operational readiness.

Partner with Engineering and other system owners to identify shared dependencies, coordinate recovery procedures, and address risks that span multiple technology functions.
Report material continuity risks, recovery readiness, and remediation progress to Technology leadership.

Cybersecurity and Technology Risk Management

Protect YPO's organizational and member data by establishing and maintaining effective enterprise security policies, controls, and risk management practices.
Lead YPO's enterprise information security program, including cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and data protection.
Oversee enterprise security monitoring, threat detection, security incident response, investigation, and remediation coordination.
Partners with Engineering, Product, Data, Legal, and Risk and Compliance to ensure security and privacy requirements are incorporated into technology solutions and operations.
Oversee the evaluation and implementation of appropriate cybersecurity frameworks, third-party technology security assessments, audits, and certifications.
Build a strong security culture through associate awareness, training, and clear accountability for protecting YPO systems and data.
Maintain visibility into material cybersecurity risks and regularly report security posture, incidents, and remediation progress to leadership.

Technology Vendor and Financial Management

Establish disciplined oversight of YPO's technology vendors, software portfolio, and investments to reduce unnecessary spending, duplication, and operational risk.
Lead enterprise technology vendor management, including software governance, vendor performance, contract oversight, license management, and cost optimization.
Oversee the centralized software intake and evaluation process to ensure new technology investments meet business needs, security requirements, and financial expectations.
Drive software portfolio rationalization by identifying opportunities to consolidate redundant tools, eliminate underutilized licenses, and simplify YPO's technology ecosystem.
Partner with Finance and department leaders to improve technology budgeting, cost allocation, forecasting, and financial accountability.
Use data, AI, and automation to improve visibility into technology spending, license utilization, vendor performance, and cost-saving opportunities.

People Leadership and Strategic Oversight

Build a high-performing technology operations organization that balances security, reliability, service quality, and financial discipline.
Lead, coach, and develop managers and associates across enterprise IT operations, cybersecurity, and technology vendor management.
Translate organizational priorities into a clear technology operations strategy, roadmap, and measurable performance objectives.
Establish accountability, service standards, operating procedures, and performance metrics across all areas of responsibility.
Manage assigned technology operations budgets, resources, and vendor investments to ensure effective allocation and financial stewardship.
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to align security standards, operational dependencies, and technology governance requirements.
Collaborate with department leaders to understand organizational needs, identify operational risks, and prioritize improvements that deliver value.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, cross-functional collaboration, ownership, and proactive problem-solving.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance service delivery.
Communicate technology performance, risks, investment needs, and operational priorities clearly to executive leadership and other stakeholders.

Enterprise IT Operations and Resilience

Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, corporate networks, identity management, end-user technology, and IT service management.
Knowledge of business continuity, disaster recovery, operational resilience, and technology risk management.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Engineering and other system owners on shared infrastructure, security requirements, and operational dependencies.

Cybersecurity and Risk

Strong knowledge of information security, cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, data protection, and incident response.
Understanding of relevant security frameworks, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into practical, business-friendly processes.
Ability to assess and mitigate enterprise technology, vendor, and AI-related security risks.

Technology and Financial Management

Strong financial acumen, including technology budgeting, forecasting, cost optimization, and investment prioritization.
Ability to establish governance processes that balance organizational needs, operational efficiency, and risk.

AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance service delivery.
